summary: First run of the new cloud job: read the fresh weekly-scrape-data release (2 days old, 77 competitors / 1,336 products), confirmed the batch-2 persistence bug is still dropping ~40% of the catalogue, and found a new root cause for 2 consecutive scrape failures (09-07, 09-14): playwright/firefox version drift between pip and npx installs. Findings written to findings/kci-data-quality.md; no code changed.
